text:
maria-finance: Heads up — vendor 'Nordic Logs AS' invoiced us with 25% VAT on invoice NL-223 dated 2026-03-10. We expected net / reverse-charge treatment. Invoice PDF attached to AP ticket. Can someone confirm next steps?
chris-legal: Quick note — Norway is outside EU, so EU reverse-charge doesn't automatically apply. We need their Norwegian VAT reg (MVA) number or proof they're a non-taxable person. Ask for VAT reg + business registration extract. If they can't provide, we need a credit note and renegotiate.
ashley-sales: FYI I spoke with their account rep yesterday; they said the VAT was added in error. They're willing to reissue but asked for a short email template.
dan-engineering: We shouldn't eat the VAT cost on top of the PO. Contract line items are net. Put the invoice on hold until it's resolved.
tax-bot: Reminder — vendor taxonomy missing fields: VAT_registration_number, business_certificate. Attach docs to vendor record to clear AP hold.
maria-finance: Drafting email to vendor. Proposal: 1) Reissue invoice without VAT and reference reverse charge/legal basis OR 2) Provide Norwegian VAT reg + proof of VAT liability so we can reclaim if appropriate. Also need their bank details confirmation for the reissued invoice.
chris-legal: Suggested template (please copy/paste):
```
Hi {vendor_contact},

Thanks for the invoice NL-223. Our records show this is a B2B supply to Redwood Inference (Redwood Inference AS). Could you please either:

1) Reissue the invoice without Norwegian VAT (MVA) and add the following note: "Reverse charge — recipient liable for VAT" (if applicable), or

2) Provide your Norwegian VAT registration number and a current business registration extract showing VAT status so we can review reclaim options.

Please also confirm bank details for payment and include "Credit note referencing NL-223" in the replacement invoice if reissuing.

Thanks,
Maria (Redwood Finance)
```
chris-legal: Also: if they refuse to reissue within 7 business days, escalate to procurement for contract remediation and keep the original invoice on hold.
nashley-sales: I'll follow up with the vendor rep after you send — can help nudge. :+1: 
maria-finance: @oliver-finance can you approve AP hold while we wait on the credit note? We'll tag procurement if no response in 7 days.
oliver-finance: Approve hold. Put a 30-day cap before we escalate to procurement/sales ops.
procurement: Noted — if vendor pushes back, procurement will request contract amendment for net pricing; tag us on the vendor thread.
maria-finance: Sent email to vendor (copied chris/legal, ashley, procurement). AP ticket updated and invoice moved to hold status. I'll post updates here when we get docs or a reissued invoice.
maria-finance: Next steps checklist — 1) vendor reissue or supply VAT reg (MVA) & business extract; 2) treasury confirm bank details on reissue; 3) AP reprocess net invoice and reverse VAT charge; 4) update vendor record with VAT number.
chris-legal: Also keep a note of taxable place-of-supply reasoning in the ticket for audit trail.
maria-finance: Thanks all, will update. If anyone sees related invoices from same vendor in last 6 months, flag them so we can batch any credit notes.
